deterministicEvidence.syntheticFault: A deliberately invalid candidate is followed by a model-stub correction within the same budget; this is not real Agent repair evidence

realModelEvidence.required: Two independent clean synthetic workspaces on the same fixed clean source commit

runs.diagnostic: Third phase passed business validation but unchanged workflow lost its exact version lock because JSON property order changed. Counter candidate was genuinely repaired by the Agent within the original budget.
Run 1 passed the entire six-step scenario. Run 2 passed tag candidate verification but the browser did not submit an optional completion form; no passing pair claimed.

Gemini fetch failed during first-run planning on call 3 before any candidate. Public unauthenticated HTTPS endpoint was reachable afterwards; this does not prove the failed model request recovered. No automatic retry.

Tags were corrected by the Agent and applied within the original budget. Counter generation stopped after read_member used an incorrect exact member version; read-only lookup errors were terminal instead of returned as correctable tool results.
Counter passed frozen isolated cases but discarded existing tags during complete candidate experience. Mandatory unknown-field retention was missing from unified Workspace verification.

realModelEvidence.latestFailure: Attempt 16: counter replaced task fields, losing tags during isolated experience before apply.
realModelEvidence.nextPair: Fresh pair after reviewed and committed unknown-field system protection, without changing frozen business inputs or reusing earlier runs.
realModelEvidence.naturalRepairEvidence: attempt-12 phase 1 and attempt-15 phase 0: failed candidate followed by Agent-generated passing correction in the same frozen plan and original budget; neither full pair passed.
